notes:
- Company: Spectra Dialogue Systems — product: agent-facing chat layer for mid-market SaaS vendors.
- Primary contacts: CTO Olivia Park (technical), Head of Product Marcus Liu (product/ops).
- Quoted requirement: "We need the agent to feel instant — <1.5s first token or CSAT drops."
- POC summary: hosted API quickstart went well; streaming integration works end-to-end (client receives chunks), function/tool-calling to Zendesk prototype implemented via Redwood function calling shim.
- Latency detail: p50 first-token ~0.9s, p90 ~1.6s. Customer insists p90 (or p95?) should be <=1.5s for their SLA; this is the main gating item.
- Throughput: target 100-200 concurrent active chats; average session length 6–8 messages, spikes during 09:00–11:00 PT.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — want predictable billing, surprised by token variance on very long sessions. Looking at Dedicated to cap unit cost and get priority capacity.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for key wrapping, and ability to restrict residency to US/EU.
- Product asks: 1) streaming stability at scale, 2) deterministic fallbacks (smaller model) when latency spikes, 3) SDK examples for tool calling and ticket creation, 4) tracing for per-request token breakdown.
- Quote from CTO on call: "If we can guarantee the 1.5s experience under our load, we can flip billing to production next quarter."
- Operational notes: proposed canary rollout via per-customer routing; recommended prefix caching for common KB queries.
- Docs shared: Redwood POC results (drive link), Spectra security questionnaire (drive link).
- Current ask from procurement: consolidated Dedicated pricing vs Hosted spend projection for 12 months; legal wants DPA + SOC2 report.
- Internal Redwood risk: need SE bench to support load testing + one-off tuning for quantized kernels if they pursue Dedicated.
- Next meeting planned: 2026-03-04 deep tech workshop (hosted by Diego) to validate p95 tuning and fallback policy.
additional_comments: Good fit for Redwood Optimize later (batching + cache suggestions). Customer motivated to move to Dedicated if we can close latency gap and present predictable pricing.
